title: Gentrit Desktop
description: A chartreuse desktop where the projects are the apps. Open, move and explore the work.
signature: The featured project window springs out of the dock into a full working desktop.
holdback: The visible project tabs and Incentiv facts provide more information than Studio or Hybrid. However, launchers select documents and window controls manage their shell; removing desktop styling and window movement leaves a conventional selector and reading panel. Mobile makes that underlying structure particularly clear.
slopCauses: Giant name with trailing full stop.
OS costume around conventional project documents.
